basic_info.description: This luxurious 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom unit spaciously spans 464 sq ft and is nestled in a modern complex built in 2007. The south-facing home offers beautiful natural light and breathtaking views of Oracle Park from every window, making it a perfect fit for any baseball lover. Inside, you'll find an open layout featuring a chef's kitchen equipped with stainless steel appliances, along with a convenient in-unit washer and dryer. The unit also includes one car garage parking, just steps from your front door, as well as optional storage and bike parking. This property boasts manufactured hardwood floors and new paint throughout.   The building amenities are impressive, featuring an on-site property manager, a 40-foot lap pool, a clubroom for social gatherings, a state-of-the-art fitness center, a movie theater for entertaining, and a barbecue area with a roof deck that boasts stunning views. Located within walking distance to Oracle Park, SOMA, Chase Stadium, and the Embarcadero, this home is surrounded by some of the best dining, shopping, and cafes the city has to offer. With convenient transportation options in the vibrant South Beach neighborhood and easy freeway access, right across the street from the ballpark, what else could you need?
